## Visit Farnell at Electronica 2026 and Explore Innovation


October 21, 2026


[Inline Presspage (1723 x 1391 px) (22)](https://news.avnet.com/files/images/farnell/1920_inlinepresspage1723x1391px22.png)


Farnell will exhibit at Electronica 2026 in Munich, Germany, from 10 – 13 November. Visitors can find Farnell in Avnet City, Hall B5, stand 103, to discover technology innovations, connect with technical experts and take part in a range of interactive experiences.


Under the theme


*Put Innovation to the Test* , Farnell will showcase its Innovation Spotlight, supplier innovations and interactive activities for visitors, including a virtual racing experience.


A key feature will be **Innovation Spotlight** , a series of interviews with technology leaders exploring the trends, challenges and opportunities shaping the future of engineering. Discussions will cover key areas including artificial intelligence (AI), electrification, infrastructure, automation and intelligent systems, offering perspectives on the technologies influencing product development and the wider electronics supply chain.


**Rebeca Obregon, President of Farnell,** said: “As we mark 10 years since Farnell became part of Avnet, Electronica is an opportunity to reflect on how our business has evolved and how we continue to support customers in an increasingly complex technology landscape.


"Together, the strengths and expertise of our businesses create greater value for customers while maintaining the distinct proposition they know and trust from Farnell. We look forward to welcoming visitors to our stand to explore the technologies shaping the future of electronics and share ideas with the wider engineering community.”


Visitors can also experience Farnell’s interactive virtual racing challenge, where they can test their skills against the competition, alongside activities celebrating the element14 Community. These will include discovering new Design Challenges, learning about the RoadTest Product Review Program and meeting MayerMakes, known for appearances on the element14 Presents YouTube channel.


The stand will also offer visitors the chance to enter prize draws, including opportunities to win Raspberry Pi Pico boards and other technology prizes.


With expert insights and hands-on experiences throughout the exhibition, the **Farnell stand in Avnet City, Hall B5, stand 103** , will offer plenty to explore.


For more information, visit


[uk.farnell.com/mc/electronica](https://uk.farnell.com/mc/electronica)
